description: Issues deliberately planted in the synthetic Northwind sample documents. Used by eval/run_eval.py (Phase 5) to measure recall. Sources are referenced by file name and a quote fragment, not by segment ID, so the list stays valid if document numbering changes.

findings.summary: Claim submission window differs: 45 days (transcript, after correction) vs 60 days (BRD) vs 90 days (policy).
Manager approval threshold: above 500 (transcript) vs above INR 1,000 (BRD) vs all claims (policy).
'Approvals should happen quickly' has no measurable SLA.
Rejection and resubmission flow is undefined.
'GL code' is never defined, and its source list is not specified.
SMS notification was only proposed, not decided. It must not become a confirmed requirement.
sources: Maybe we could also send an SMS

findings.summary: Threshold '500' has no currency; the receipt rule says 'original receipts' (policy) vs upload as PDF/image (transcript).
Payroll/payment integration is still to be confirmed. The policy says claims are paid with monthly payroll.
sources: Payment integration with the payroll system

findings.summary: The resubmission question has no speaker.

must_not_happen: SMS notification marked as STATED or approved without human action
30-day window used as final without noting the later correction to 45 days
Currency or SLA values invented for '500' or 'quickly'
